title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In September 2026, French Roofing replaced a worn, mossy shingle roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off the old shingles, laid new synthetic underlayment over the deck, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Installed APOC Weather-Armor Cross Over synthetic underlayment
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
body: Before the work started, moss and leaf debris had settled into the old shingles across the roof. The photos below follow the job from the worn roof, through the tear-off and the new underlayment, to the finished shingles.

photos.caption: Tear-off in progress.

photos.caption: New synthetic underlayment, ready for shingles.

faqs.question: Did French Roofing remove the old roof on this Portland job?
faqs.answer: Yes. The old shingles came off down to the roof deck before anything new went on, so the new underlayment and shingles sit on a clean deck instead of on top of an old layer.

faqs.question: What shingles were installed?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, over APOC Weather-Armor Cross Over synthetic underlayment.
